hypothesis: More independent real revision supervision with replay can improve the underlying evidence model after three cheap head/calibration/interpolation changes failed. The intervention is an additional training stage, not proof that data alone causes any gain.
model: Warm-start trusted1921 checkpoint, same MiniLM/Roberta6layer architecture and tokenizer; one fixed epoch, AdamW2e-5 weight_decay.01, batch8, gradientclip1, maximum256 tokens, seed1935; optimizer reset explicitly. No full generative model training or architecture rewrite.
data: Approximately6400 new full real contrastive training pairs,1600 prior VitaminC replay,1600 FEVER replay. Globally connected page/case/exact claim/span split; exclude all previously selected components before choosing fresh training/risk/locked cohorts. Human original labels only. Existing validation207 and fit1000 remain development/calibration respectively;1000 new independent risk and600 new test queries sealed before training.
resources: One private AWS CPU instance only, existing regional GPU quota0. Reserve10USD within300 ceiling before launch. Verify regional CPU quota, actual running use, on-demand pricing and image owner first. No SSH/public application endpoint; no access to existing project buckets. New bounded role only for task-owned S3prefixes; encrypted root disk, IMDSv2, shutdown-terminate behavior and independent45minute systemd watchdog. Trainingtimeout1800seconds, shell timeout2400seconds, cloud cleanup recorded. Instance cost reservation is not an account-wide spending hard cap.
gate: First evaluate equally supervised logistic head against frozen1921 on reused validation. Require >=2point raw accuracy or correct-definitive gain, raw loss<=1point and coverage loss<=2points; then new exact independent risk alpha.05/2 at80% floor, n>=30. Freeze selection before600 fresh locked queries, paired accuracy/coverage margins.01/.02. No production/public promotion from development gains.
limits: One run/epoch, no checkpoint selection using validation, no train-on-test, no automatic instance replacement or hyperparameter sweep. Keep original/best checkpoints and reject if gates fail. Public release remains gated.
